semantic_interpretation: I05 adds no raw-denominator adequacy floor beyond the exact typed support states already emitted by I03. This value does not state that denominator zero or one is statistically adequate; it states only that this production profile does not introduce a new count threshold.

effects.low_support: LOW_SUPPORT remains an I03 empirical-fact state and remains visible in discovery support summaries; this rule does not add a count-floor override that relabels it UNDERPOWERED.
effects.underpowered: EVALUATED_UNDERPOWERED is intentionally unreachable through this count-floor field under this rule. The vocabulary remains part of the frozen engine and may become reachable only under a separately authorized and newly versioned positive support rule or another exact operation-valid support authority.
effects.valid_empty: All-zero-denominator or ZERO_SUPPORT/VALID_EMPTY candidate fact sets are classified by the existing terminal fact law before the minimum-denominator check; this rule does not change VALID_EMPTY.
effects.observed_zero: OBSERVED_ZERO already requires positive raw denominator and zero numerator; this rule does not change it.
effects.uncertainty_unquantified: UNCERTAINTY_UNQUANTIFIED remains exactly unquantified. No estimator, confidence rule, effect threshold, or power claim is introduced.
